name: sello
description: Prepare Markdown journal entries for review and manual saving in Sello.

interface.longDescription: Turn notes, summaries, and conversations into Markdown journal drafts for Sello, a private end-to-end encrypted journal. The plugin only prepares text and displays a Save to Sello card; it never saves an entry itself. Review the draft in Sello and choose to save it there. Sello can also publish only the entries you choose, but this plugin cannot read, search, edit, delete, or publish entries.
defaultPrompt: Save this note to my Sello journal.
Turn our conversation into a Sello journal entry.
Guarda este resumen en mi diario de Sello.

prompts: Save this note in my Sello journal.
Turn our conversation into a journal entry for Sello.
Guarda este resumen en mi diario de Sello.
Convierte lo que hablamos en una entrada de diario.

positive.prompt: Guarda este resumen en mi diario de Sello: El equipo aprobó el calendario de entregas.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_sello_entry(title="Resumen de equipo", text="El equipo aprobó el calendario de entregas.")
positive.expected_behavior: A preparation card with Guardar en Sello is displayed; user must review and save it in Sello. No saved-success claim.

positive.prompt: Convierte lo que hablamos hoy en una entrada de diario de Sello.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_sello_entry(title=<short factual title>, text=<Markdown based only on available conversation>)
positive.expected_behavior: Only supported conversation details appear in the card. If no discussion content is available, ask for it; do not invent.

positive.prompt: Save this in my Sello journal: Today I finished my first project.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_sello_entry(title="First project", text="Today I finished my first project.")
positive.expected_behavior: English text is preserved and a review-and-save card appears. No claim of persistence.

positive.prompt: Envía a Sello estas ideas: caminar cada día, leer más y descansar mejor.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_sello_entry(title=<short relevant title>, text="- Caminar cada día\n- Leer más\n- Descansar mejor")
positive.expected_behavior: Markdown list remains faithful to user-provided ideas. Card opens an Sello review flow.

positive.prompt: Prepara en Sello una entrada titulada "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" con el texto "Prueba de límite".
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_sello_entry(title=<exact 190-character supplied title>, text="Prueba de límite")
positive.expected_behavior: Title is preserved within the 200-character maximum, and the review card is displayed.

negative.prompt: Borra mi última entrada de Sello.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Sello: prepare journal drafts with an interactive review-and-save card.
